response.original_title: 《@FAQ’s~Solutions》 How to communicate on Cunard Cruise?
response.overview: You can communicate on a Cunard cruise by using the complimentary My Voyage digital planner on the ship's Wi-Fi, purchasing a paid Wi-Fi package for messaging apps, or using stateroom phones.  Onboard Wi-Fi and Digital Tools My Voyage: Connect to Cunard_Guest_WIFI for free without buying an internet plan. You can use it via your browser to check daily schedules, view menus, manage bookings, and access virtual restaurant queues. Internet Packages: Purchase a paid Wi-Fi plan to access third-party apps like WhatsApp, iMessage, and Facebook Messenger for standard texting and calling +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK)  Traditional and Off-Ship Options Stateroom Phones: Use cabin phones for internal ship calls or room-to-room communication. Cellular at Sea: Available via satellite roaming, though this incurs high per-minute or per-message fees from your home carrier. Airplane mode is recommended until you reach port.
